page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i4r.16xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs provided by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz. The instance is equipped with 512.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU.

For local storage requirements, the ecs.i4r.16xlarge includes a bundled 3839 GB local SSD. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps. The instance does not include any integrated GPU hardware or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the combination of dedicated Intel Xeon processing cores, a high memory-to-core ratio, and substantial local SSD storage provides a dense resource profile suitable for demanding enterprise workloads. This hardware configuration is optimized for memory-intensive applications, large-scale databases, real-time data processing, and high-throughput storage-bound workloads that benefit from low-latency local solid-state storage.

The instance includes a bundled 3839 GB local SSD for high-speed, low-latency storage operations, alongside a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps. With no integrated GPU hardware, this server is engineered for non-accelerated enterprise applications. The combination of dedicated processing power, large memory capacity, and substantial local solid-state storage makes the ecs.i4r.16xlarge highly efficient for hosting large-scale databases, real-time data analytics, and memory-optimized enterprise applications.
